newsitem.title: USA: Exxon restarts Louisiana crude unit, coker.
newsitem.headline: Exxon restarts Louisiana crude unit, coker.

text.p: Exxon Corp said Thursday evening it had restarted a crude distillation unit and a coker shut last month for scheduled maintenance at the company's 432,000-barrel-per day refinery in Baton Rouge, Lousiana.
Exxon spokesman Bruce Tackett said a 73,000 bpd crude distillation unit taken down on January 10 was returned to service on Wednesday.
He added that a 33,000 bpd coker shut down on January 25 was brought back on Tuesday.
"It's proceeding as planned," Tackett said, of the refinery's ongoing maintenance turnaround.
